items.title: India's Chandrayaan-3 Spacecraft Lands on Moon's South Pole
items.snippet_en: VOA News reports that India successfully placed the Vikram lander in the moon's southern polar region on Wednesday evening, August 23, 2023.

items.title: India becomes fourth country to land on moon, first to reach south pole
items.snippet_en: PBS.org states that India landed a spacecraft near the moon's south pole on Wednesday, August 23, 2023, at 6:04 local time.

items.title: India’s Chandrayaan-3 lands on the Moon’s south pole
items.snippet_en: Astronomy.com confirms that on August 23, 2023, the Indian Space Research Organization's (ISRO) Chandrayaan-3 mission, with its Vikram lander, made a soft landing near the Moon's south pole.

items.title: How India Beat Russia to the Moon’s South Pole
items.snippet_en: Time.com reports that on August 23, 2023, India's Chandrayaan-3 set down gently in the polar dust at 8:34 AM ET.

items.title: Chandrayaan-3
items.snippet_en: Wikipedia states that Chandrayaan-3 touched down near the lunar south pole on August 23, 2023, at 18:04 IST (12:33 UTC).

items.title: Chandrayaan-3: India’s Historic Lunar South Pole Landing
items.snippet_en: ResearchExperts.in confirms that on August 23, 2023, both the Vikram lander and the Pragyan rover successfully touched down near the lunar south pole area.

items.title: India's Chandrayaan-3 Spacecraft Lands on Moon's South Pole
items.snippet_en: VOA News reports that India made history by becoming the first country to touch down on an uncharted part of the lunar surface, the moon's southern polar region.

items.title: India becomes fourth country to land on moon, first to reach south pole
items.snippet_en: PBS.org states that India made history by becoming the first country to touch down near the little-explored south pole region.

items.title: India becomes first country to land spacecraft on moon’s south pole
items.snippet_en: TheGuardian.com reports that India became the first country to successfully land a spacecraft near the south pole of the moon.

items.title: Chandrayaan-3
items.snippet_en: Wikipedia states that with this landing, ISRO became the first in human history to achieve a soft landing near the lunar south pole.

items.title: Chandrayaan-3: India’s Historic Lunar South Pole Landing
items.snippet_en: ResearchExperts.in notes that the landing on August 23, 2023, was a historic first for India, as both the Vikram lander and the Pragyan rover successfully touched down near the lunar south pole area.

items.title: Chandrayaan-3
items.snippet_en: Eoportal.org states that the mission demonstrated the first soft landing in the Southern Polar region of the Moon.
